digest.overview: 本期焦點是日月光再砸 2,489 億元在高雄仁武興建高階測試新廠,加上先前路竹廠,仁武雙基地合計投資逾 3,663 億元,AI 測試產能預計 2029 年前到位,封測設備與 PVD 製程材料需求可望延續。中國方面,長電科技 XDFOI 已量產,華天科技推進南京二期與 FOPLP,微導納米推出兩款 PVD 設備。靶材廠方面,江豐電子上半年淨利年增 113.61%,靶材產能滿載待擴;JX金屬則因 LME 銅價下跌與 AI 投資減速疑慮,股價跌至年初以來新低。貴金屬全面重挫,聯準會偏鷹,金價跌破 3,650 美元、創 14 個月新低,白銀與鈀金跌幅逾 4%。

papers.title: Effects of Target‐Selective HiPIMS on Microstructure and Thermoelectric Transport in Pd‐Doped Bi 2 Te 3 Thin Films on Al 2 O 3 Substrates
papers.abstract: Pd‐doped Bi 2 Te 3 thin films were deposited on Al 2 O 3 substrates using magnetron cosputtering with direct‐current (DC), pulsed‐DC (DC‐P), and high‐power impulse magnetron sputtering (HiPIMS) to investigate the effects of deposition configuration and annealing on microstructure and thermoelectric (TE) transport. HiPIMS was selectively applied to either the Bi 2 Te 3 or Pd target, followed by vacuum annealing at 250 °C. Deposition rates increased when HiPIMS was applied to the Pd target but decreased when applied to the Bi 2 Te 3 target. FESEM revealed nanocolumnar films approximately 400 nm thick, while annealing promoted grain growth and microstructural evolution. GI‐XRD and HRTEM indicated improved crystalline ordering, with additional diffraction features suggesting possible PdTe 2 secondary‐phase formation. Hall‐effect and temperature‐dependent TE measurements revealed deposition‐dependent changes in carrier transport. All films exhibited n‐type conduction. Among the investigated configurations, annealed DC‐P (Bi 2 Te 3 )/HiPIMS (Pd) films achieved the highest Seebeck coefficient magnitude of 78.10 μV K −1 and maximum power factor of 0.91 μW cm −1 K −2 at 200 °C. These findings demonstrate the importance of target‐selective HiPIMS and annealing in controlling microstructure and TE transport in Pd‐containing Bi 2 Te 3 thin films.
